```verilog
/**************************************************************************

** Component : R41P                                                      **

** Last reviewed: 9-FEB-2025                                             **
** Ronny Hansen                                                          **
***************************************************************************/

module R41P (
    input CP,

    input A,
    input B,
    input C,
    input D,

    output QA,
    output QAN,
    output QB,
    output QBN,
    output QC,
    output QCN,
    output QD,
    output QDN
);



reg [3:0] reg8bit;

assign QA   = reg8bit[0];
assign QAN  = ~reg8bit[0];

assign QB   = reg8bit[1];
assign QBN  = ~reg8bit[1];

assign QC   = reg8bit[2];
assign QCN  = ~reg8bit[2];

assign QD   = reg8bit[3];
assign QDN  = ~reg8bit[3];

always @(posedge CP) begin
    reg8bit[0] <= A;
    reg8bit[1] <= B;
    reg8bit[2] <= C;
    reg8bit[3] <= D;
end

endmodule
```
